supersession_status.description:
Whether this record still stands. Named apart from Stateful's `status` so an object can carry
both a lifecycle and a supersession lineage.

superseded_by.description:
Identifier of the record that replaced this one. Present when the store records the forward
pointer. Absent means not replaced, or not known — the two are distinguished by
supersession_status, never by the pointer alone.

supersedes.description:
Identifier of the record this one replaced. Present when the store records the backward
pointer. Never inferred from ordering.

superseded_at.description:
When the replacement happened, when the store records it. CMOS does not, so a Decision leaves
it absent rather than borrowing the replacement's creation time.

supersession_reason.description: Why the record was replaced, when the store carries a reason.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the entity was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the most recent modification, when available.

last_event.description: Lifecycle event associated with the most recent timestamp mutation.

last_event_at.description: Timestamp for the lifecycle event captured in last_event.

classification_metadata.description: Operational metadata describing mode, storage model, governance rules, and audit timestamps.

categories.description: Ordered taxonomy nodes scoped to the object.

primary_category_id.description: Identifier of the canonical taxonomy node.

tags.description: Canonical tag collection after synonym collapse.

tag_count.description: Number of canonical tags assigned to the object.

tag_preview.description: Denormalized comma-delimited preview for list renders.

searchQuery.description: The current search query string entered by the user.

searchActive.description: Whether the search input is currently focused or has a non-empty query.

filters.description:
Array of available filter descriptors. Each entry defines a filterable dimension:
  - field: string (the schema field to filter on)
  - label: string (display label)
  - type: "select" | "multi-select" | "range" | "boolean" | "date-range"
  - options: array of { value, label } for select/multi-select types

activeFilters.description:
Array of currently applied filter values:
  - field: string (matches a filter descriptor field)
  - operator: "eq" | "in" | "range" | "gt" | "lt" | "between"
  - value: unknown (the selected filter value or values)

filterCount.description: Computed count of currently active filters.

pageSize.description: Number of items displayed per page.

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages. Used to compute total page count.

totalPages.description: Computed total number of pages (ceil(totalItems / pageSize)).

decision_id.description: The record's own identifier. CMOS assigns an integer; the object declares a string so the same shape carries another store's identifiers without coercion.

decision_text.description: The decision as it was written. The longest free text this registry carries: 61 to 8,418 characters in the live store, with 197 of 1,933 rows over 2,000, so every context that shows it must stay readable at 390 without hiding meaning.

sprint_id.description: The sprint the decision was taken in. Every non-null value in the live store resolves against a sprint, none dangling.

mission_id.description: The mission that captured it, as CMOS stores it. Recorded loosely — often a bare "m02" rather than a fully qualified "s203-m02" — so it is shown as a label and never as a resolved link.

session_id.description: The session that recorded the decision. Null on 838 of 1,933 rows.

project_id.description: The project the decision belongs to. A slug such as "forge", never a uuid.

project_domain.description: Optional area within the project. Sparse — null on 1,850 of 1,933 rows.

evidence.description: What the decision cites, as {type, id} references. Sparse (null on 1,923 rows) but real, and the rows a preview shows beside a design.
